headline: Newark is lagging under low clouds; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into Newark (EWR) until 11:59 PM ET because of low clouds, holding those flights at their departure airports with delays averaging 105 minutes and up to 214 minutes. Newark is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting so far today, at 67% of departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (250 departed).
The other hubs are running normally.
630 United flights, including United Express, are in the air right now, about the usual for this time of day; the 7-day median at this hour is 641.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying into Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, since flights into Newark are being held at their departure airports until 11:59 PM ET.
